== Biography ==

Mrs. Rabbit is the mother of four young rabbits dwelling in a sand-bank beneath the root of a great fir-tree. A cautious guardian, she warned her children against venturing into Mr. McGregor's garden, where their father met a terrible accident—he was caught by Mrs. McGregor and made into a pie. Before departing one morning with her basket and umbrella to visit the baker, she reminded her little ones to remain out of mischief. She returned home with a loaf of brown bread and five currant buns.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Cotton]]''' — family. Cotton is one of Rabbit's children.

'''[[Mopsy]]''' — family. Mopsy is one of Rabbit's children.

'''[[Peter]]''' — family. Peter is one of Rabbit's children; when he returns home ill from his adventures, Rabbit puts him to bed and gives him camomile tea to help him recover.
